event.location_text: MALACCA STRAIT Off Pisang Island (Malaysia), in the westbound lane of the Traffic Separation Scheme (TSS) Malaysia 01° 24.35' N

sources.title: Piracy monthly report March 2024
sources.text: While the tug boat towing drill ship was underway, the crew noticed four perpetrators had boarded the unmanned drill ship from a small fishing boat via the excess ladder on starboard side. The general alarm was sounded, and the master reported and requested for assistance from Klang VTS. The incident was also reported to the CSO.
